name: Sarah Goher
bio: Sarah Goher is an Egyptian-American writer and producer, born and bred in the South Bronx. An alumna of NYU Tisch and the Nightingale Bamford School, Sarah worked on “Cairo 678” (2010), “Clash” (2016), “Amira” (2021) and Marvel Studios' “Moon Knight" (2022). "Happy Birthday" (2025) marks her directorial debut.
place: The Bronx, New York City, New York, USA

credits.title: Happy Birthday
credits.overview: Eight-year-old maid Toha goes to great lengths to ensure that her best friend Nelly, the daughter of her wealthy employer, has a successful birthday party in this poignant debut feature exploring classism in modern-day Cairo.

credits.title: Amira
credits.overview: Amira, a 17 year old Palestinian, was conceived with the smuggled sperm of her imprisoned father, Nawar. credits.title: Clash
credits.overview: In 2013, in Cairo, a tragic fate brings together several detainees from different political and social backgrounds inside a police truck, during the turmoil that followed the ousting of president Morsi.

credits.title: Cairo 6,7,8
credits.overview: Three women seek justice due to the difficult daily situation which sexual harassment causes in the streets of Cairo, Egypt.
